units.title: Node label measurement and selected leaf geometry

source_scope.implementation: syson-node-measurement; actual F19 wrapper uses package-leaf policy with DOM-observed labels
source_scope.classes: Package leaf, view-frame leaf and note core contracts; only the finite package/part preview is browser-bound

functional_expectations: Preserve exact label target and layout/font/request stamp; wrong or stale observations refuse. None/zero/forced dimensions retain the pinned finite source distinctions.
Package/view-frame leaves retain75x50 minima and8+label-height+8 padding. Notes use their separate border/default/aspect policy. Parent layout is F18, not silently treated as a leaf.
All admitted dimensions are finite/nonnegative and computation returns no partial model mutation. Matching observation tokens do not authenticate a caller or prove DOM measurement.

performance_ranges.admitted: One node request; previous/visible-ID searches are linear in caller observations. F19 bounds its browser label packet to1MiB and32 supported nodes.

units.title: Deterministic flat directed layout

source_scope.implementation: syson-layout::layout; iterative SCC condensation, longest-path ranks and weak-component bands
source_scope.source_disposition: Explicit proposed Rust algorithm, not an ELK translation

functional_expectations: Borrow measured rectangles and preserve dimensions/edge identities. Canonical ID order makes admitted input permutations deterministic.

Only flat, unpinned, port-free nodes and Right/Down are admitted. Unknown endpoints, invalid numbers, unsupported constraints, allocation/precision/work failures and cancellation return no partial layout.
Inter-SCC edges advance in rank; same-layer nodes and weak-component bands do not overlap under finite arithmetic. Do not promise minimum crossings, area or native aesthetics.

performance_ranges.admitted: Default caps4096 nodes/16384 edges,100,000,000 logical work,16MiB estimated workspace and1024-byte IDs. Count caps are necessary bounds, not a promise every graph under those counts passes the conservative work budget.
performance_ranges.complexity: Iterative graph traversals avoid recursive DFS. Sort work is conservatively precharged with length-squared/key-byte bounds. Logical work/workspace excludes RSS and is not a wall-clock deadline.

units.title: Finite orthogonal obstacle routing

source_scope.implementation: syson-routing grid/BFS with exact doubled-integer endpoints and open-interior obstacle checks
source_scope.source_disposition: Proposed finite zero-clearance router; not ELK routing equivalence

functional_expectations: Require unique IDs, positive integer rectangles and rectangle edges within +/-1,000,000 units; refuse fractional/nonfinite/interior-overlap geometry.
Route Left/Right/Top/Bottom side-center anchors in the core API; sides constrain anchor position, not departure heading. Preserve half-unit centers as doubled integers.
Returned nonzero orthogonal segments must avoid every open rectangle interior; zero-clearance boundary/corner contact remains allowed. Distinct-side self and parallel edges retain identity.
Errors/cancellation produce no partial route collection. Grid-hop BFS does not promise shortest metric length, fewest bends, crossing avoidance or parallel lane separation.

performance_ranges.admitted: Default caps128 nodes/256 edges,16,384 grid vertices,65,536 output points,20,000,000 logical work and1024-byte IDs. F19 narrows counts to32/64.
performance_ranges.complexity: Each candidate segment checks rectangles; routing cost grows with grid, obstacles and edge count. Work/grid limits may refuse before count limits.

units.title: Measured canvas composition, history and WASM binding

source_scope.implementation: F19A geometry + F19B controller + F19C App/loader/SVG; three ordered original PRs

functional_expectations: Real DOM measurements feed actual F15/F18/F17 computation; no duplicate fake geometry. Model and representation identity domains remain distinct.

Request/compute/apply use monotonically increasing controller-scoped tickets and exact canonical model binding. Selection/font/model changes invalidate queued work; stale/cancelled results cannot publish or create extra history.
Canvas undo/redo is distinct from semantic history and bounded to32 frames; model edits/imports invalidate canvas geometry/history.
Rotate only selected leaves. Selected nodes/incident routes adopt results while unselected geometry is retained; explicitly relayout package bounds afterward.

Companion JSON requires exact model/version/identity/geometry/endpoint checks before state mutation; file and escaped default-ABI packet must fit1MiB. Imported geometry is file data, not a solver/DOM attestation.

performance_ranges.admitted: At most32 Package/PartDefinition/PartUsage nodes and64 same-parent local semantic-ID typing edges;1MiB request/model/companion/default-ABI budgets; finite integer geometry with half-unit routes;32 history frames.
performance_ranges.execution: Two zero-delay callbacks split compute and apply on the browser main thread. F19 passes noncancelling callbacks into synchronous algorithms; user cancellation is between phases, not preemptive or off-thread.

units.title: Inspector keyboard, focus and persistent live status

source_scope.implementation: Bounded InspectorAccessibility focus policy and persistent status-node loader update
source_scope.remediation_capture: Current root navigation/inspector refinement uses nav-03 build and audit-ui-navigation-02 browser capture, separate from originalF36baseline

functional_expectations: Keyboard create/select/rename/scalar staging must preserve committed export until commit; cancel must restore model state, and commit/cancel returns focus to the recorded origin.
All visible controls need computed accessible names, visible focus and predictable Tab order. SVG is aria-hidden, so the model/relationship navigation must provide the accessible alternative.
The live-status DOM object remains connected with stable status/polite/atomic success semantics and alert/assertive error semantics; do not remove/recreate it or clear attributes during repaint.

Pending edits must retain their original selected target; a selection change cannot silently redirect a commit. Unsupported/read-only properties need reasons and cannot become editable through presentation changes.

performance_ranges.measured_states: nav02 PASS at1365x1000,390x844 and320x844; no console errors/warnings; same status backend10 and named focused textbox/combobox captured. These are state/semantics checks, not timing distributions.
